source: GSO/NSO — National Statistics Office of Vietnam (nso.gov.vn)
tls_note: CRITICAL: www.gso.gov.vn cert SAN=nso.gov.vn (mismatch). Use nso.gov.vn domain with GlobalSign intermediate CA. Recipe: download http://secure.globalsign.com/cacert/gsrsaovsslca2018.crt → convert DER→PEM → cat /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt <int.pem> > /tmp/combined.pem → curl --cacert /tmp/combined.pem https://www.nso.gov.vn/...
data_format: Excel downloads (.xlsx) per indicator + HTML press release pages (text content, no HTML tables)
parse_strategy: EXCEL DOWNLOAD PATH — HTML pages have 0 HTML tables; all structured data is in Excel downloads. Excel path is stable and machine-readable.

fdi.note: FDI in sheet 12 is by province; national total embedded in press release text

cpi_11_baskets.basket_count_note: 15 categories in sheet (some are subcategories; NSO uses 11 main groups officially)
cpi_11_baskets.weights_note: Weights (trọng số) NOT in the Excel table. Weights from CPI methodology PDF (updated ~every 5 years). CPI index values per basket are present for multiple reference periods.

public_investment.note: Public investment (Vốn đầu tư) - separate sheet in monthly Excel

month_stability: URL slug changes monthly (month name in Vietnamese). Use index page https://www.nso.gov.vn/bao-cao-tinh-hinh-kinh-te-xa-hoi-hang-thang/ to discover latest URL.
excel_stability: Excel upload path uses same date pattern but month number may vary (T5 for May, T4 for April, etc.) and slug suffix changes. Must discover URL from press release page.

recommended_parse_config.strategy: Excel download (not HTML — no HTML tables in press release)
recommended_parse_config.discovery: GET index URL → extract latest bai-top/ link → GET press release page → extract .xlsx download link → GET Excel
recommended_parse_config.parser_note: Must use excelize (Go) or openpyxl (Python) — NOT html table parser
